subject: Princess Ruto
text: Ruto waits on the other side of the door in the Crawling Hallway to be picked up.

evidence.quote: Ruto will be waiting for you on the other side of the door.

subject: Crawling Hallway
text: From the blue switch, head to the left through the unblocked door to reach the Shabom Room.

evidence.quote: Pick the royal pain up, then go to the left from the blue switch.  This door is now unblocked.  Go through it.

subject: Shabom Room
text: Defeating all the Shaboms within forty seconds reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: This room requires you to kill a pack of Shaboms in forty seconds...Use both to defeat all of the Shaboms.  A chest will appear upon their demise.  Open it to find the Compass.

subject: Crawling Hallway
text: In the Crawling Hallway, proceed down the hall, take a left, go straight, and take another left to reach the door to the Blue Tentacle Room.

evidence.quote: Go down the hall, take a left, go straight, then left again.  Go through the door.

subject: Blue Tentacle
text: Hitting the Blue Tentacle with the Boomerang four times while dodging its strikes defeats it and removes all Blue Tentacles in the dungeon.

evidence.quote: Hit it with the boomerang, run forward to make it strike at you, then hit it with the boomerang again while dodging the attack.  Hit it four times to kill it.  All of the Blue Tentacles around the dungeon will now disappear.

subject: Crawling Hallway
text: In the Crawling Hallway, go right down the hall and take another right to reach the door to the Green Tentacle Room.

evidence.quote: Go right down the hall, then take another right.  Go through the door at the end of the hall.

subject: Green Tentacle
text: Eliminating the Biri and striking the Green Tentacle four times with the Boomerang defeats it and makes all Green Tentacles disappear.

evidence.quote: Eliminate the Biri first, then turn your attention to the Tentacle.  Hit it with the boomerang, run forward to make it strike at you, then hit it with the boomerang again while dodging the attack.  Hit it four times to kill it.  All of the Green Tentacles around the dungeon will now disappear.

subject: Crawling Hallway
text: Running straight across the Crawling Hallway leads back to the Pit Room.

evidence.quote: Run straight across the hallway back to the Pit Room.

subject: Pit Room
text: Dropping down the pit closest to the west wall, to the right when entering from the Crawling Hallway, accesses the lower area with Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: If you weren't paying attention the last time you were here, the pit is the one closest to the west wall, to the right as you come in from the Crawling Hallway.  Drop down this pit.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Facing north after dropping down the west pit reveals two Gold Skulltulas on the wall that can be defeated and collected with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: When you land, set down Ruto and face the north.  You will see not one, but two Gold Skulltulas on the wall.  Kill them both with the Boomerang, then use the Boomerang again to claim their Tokens.

subject: Bigocto
text: Bigocto's weakpoint is a large green eye on his backside, which can be damaged with Jump Attacks after stunning him with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: His weakpoint is a large green "eye" on his backside.  The Bigocto is vulnerable to the Boomerang - it stuns him and locks him in place...Once you have reached his backside, stun him with the Boomerang, and use a Jump Attack to damage his green eye.

subject: Bigocto
text: Two Jump Attacks to Bigocto's green eye will defeat him.

evidence.quote: Two Jump Attacks will defeat the Bigocto.

subject: Bigocto Room
text: Stepping onto the middle platform after defeating Bigocto raises the elevator to a hallway leading south.

evidence.quote: After the Bigocto is dead, step onto the middle platform and the elevator will rise...Run south down the hall and through the door, killing any Biri who get in your way.

subject: Pink Things
text: Stunning the Pink Things with the Boomerang allows Link to jump across them to reach the next door.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, the only way to get across them is to stun them with the Boomerang.  Stun the first one with the Boomerang, then jump out onto it.  Then stun the second one, then jump to the door.

subject: Blue Switch
text: In the Elevator Room, a box from near the Pit Room door must be placed on the blue switch to keep it depressed.

evidence.quote: Run around to the door by the Pit Room and grab one of the boxes, then step onto the blue button.  The button will depress.  Drop the box so that it sits on the button, forcing it to stay activated.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the ivy wall in the southeast side of the Biri Room.

evidence.quote: Kill all of the Biri around the room, then go around to the southeast side of the room.  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the ivy wall, and climb up to take it's token.

subject: North Door
text: Hitting the switch to the right from the top of the ivy wall with the Boomerang unlocks the door in the north end of the room.

evidence.quote: At the top, look to the right to see a switch.  Z-Target it and use the Boomerang to hit it.  The door in the north end of the room will unlock.

subject: Barinade
text: In Barinade's first phase, circle the boss to avoid lightning bolts and sever the tentacles attached to the ceiling using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: His main attack in this form is to shoot bolts of lightning at you with the "satellite dishes" on his head.  Z-Target the tentacles attached to the ceiling, and begin circling the boss...Destroy the tentacles attached to the ceiling with the Boomerang.

subject: Barinade
text: Stunning Barinade's base with the Boomerang detaches the circling Baris, allowing them to be destroyed with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Dodge through the circling Biris, and stun the boss by striking it's base with the Boomerang.  The Baris will release from their bonding to Barinade, and become vulnerable.  Destroy them with your Boomerang.

subject: Barinade
text: After all Baris are destroyed, stun Barinade with the Boomerang and strike its base with five Jump Attacks to defeat it.

evidence.quote: Once all of the Baris are dead, then you enter the boss' final phase, in which you are finally able to damage him.  Stun him with your Boomerang, then run into strike it's base with Jump Attacks...After five Jump Attacks, Barinade will be defeated.

subject: Barinade
text: Defeating Barinade leaves behind a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Take the Heart Container that Barinade leaves behind, then enter the ring of shimmering blue light.

subject: Princess Ruto
text: Entering the blue teleport ring takes Link outside where Princess Ruto gives him the Zora Sapphire upon agreeing to marry her.

evidence.quote: The ring will teleport you and Ruto outside.  Ruto will give you the Zora Sapphire, but only if you agree to marry her.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At nighttime, a Gold Skulltula is located on the wall on the west side of the tree trunk that arches over the water in Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Climb up onto the large tree trunk which arches over the body of water in the south of the zone.  Go to the west side of the tree trunk and look on the wall to see a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with your Boomerang.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: The cave entrance on the west side of Zora's Fountain leads back to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: Head back through the cave entrance in the west side of the zone to return to Zora's Domain.

subject: Zora's Domain
text: Diving off the waterfall to the right of King Zora's Throne Room leads to an underwater tunnel to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: From King Zora's Throne Room, go to the right and dive off of the waterfall.  Swim down into the water and into the tunnel to Lake Hylia.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At nighttime in Lake Hylia, a Gold Skulltula is found on the rear side of the observatory when viewed from the wooden drawbridge.

evidence.quote: Look on the rear side of the observatory from the wooden drawbridge to find a Gold Skulltula.  Use the Boomerang to kill it and claim it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Bombing the center of a stone circle at the north edge of the quarry in Hyrule Field reveals a pit with a Gold Skulltula in the cow alcove behind webbing.

evidence.quote: Head into the quarry-like area, and go the north edge of it to find a circle of stones.  Drop a bomb in the middle of this circle of stones to find a hidden pit...Head for the alcove with the cow, and look on the wall in the rear of the alcove to find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Hyrule Field
text: Traveling west from the quarry area of Hyrule Field enters Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote: Go west to enter Gerudo Valley.
